reviews.title: Too focused on getting my bank account
reviews.text:
I’m trying to find an app for casting videos from my files to my smart television, so I grabbed this one because it had the most good reviews.

I got it to linked to my television, but then it immediately wanted to review, and every time I try to actually cast a video to my TV the greedy pigs want money.

No dude, I’m not going to pay for a membership to a program. I don’t even know works. Show me your work let me cast a video to the screen, THEN demand a monthly payment. There were too many scammers online for me to just trust that you’ll do it once you have my money.

The fact that you’re demanding money before you even did anything looks awfully sus.
